scope: every tracked blob at the scanned revision (git ls-tree -r); a blob containing a NUL byte is binary and skipped; lines split on \n after UTF-8 decode with errors=replace

classes.name: session_identity
classes.why: names a concrete OMP session directory or transcript of another session

classes.name: session_store_path
classes.why: a path into the session store below its root

classes.name: tool_output_artifact
classes.why: a numbered tool-output artifact of some session

classes.name: operator_config_ref
classes.why: operator routing/runtime configuration file or its line references

classes.name: routing_table_key
classes.why: keys whose values are private routing tables

classes.name: session_record_value
classes.why: session-record fields outside the round-17 metadata allowlist

adjudication_rule: A population hit outside must_redact_paths may be allowlisted only when the line carries no value copied from a private source: (a) an instruction, boundary or contract statement that names a surface without its contents; (b) a field or key name inside lane tool code, a contract or synthetic fixture; (c) a non-author file the lane may not edit (recorded as retained-by-non-author and routed). Every other hit is redacted. A must_redact_paths file may carry no allowlist entry and must scan to zero hits.
metric: C1 count = unallowlisted hits at the measured revision, excluding non_author_paths_glob; routed sub-count = hits inside must_redact_paths. Before is measured at base; after at the measured round-18 commit.
known_limit: Regex classes are a recall floor, not a privacy proof: private context without these tokens is found only by the reading sweep, recorded separately and outside the frozen metric.
